newsitem.title: USA: Micron Electronics says 13.5 mln shrs sold.
newsitem.headline: Micron Electronics says 13.5 mln shrs sold.

text.p: - Micron Electronics Inc and Micron Technology Inc said on Thursday they were selling 13.5 million shares of Micron Electronics' common stock at a price of $17 per share in an offering managed by Goldman Sachs & Co, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Montgomery Securities and Robertson Stephens & Co.
The sale of the shares is expected to close on Feb 19, 1997.

Of the total shares offered, three million are being sold by Micron Electronics and 10.5 million are being sold by selling shareholders, the companies said. Of the 10.5 million, substantially all are being sold by Micron Technology.

Micron Technology owns about 79% of the outstanding common stock of Micron Electronics. The companies said the sale reduces Micron Technology's stake to about 66%, or 64% if the over-allotment option is exercised in full.
The over-allotment option covers up to an additional 2.025 million shares.
The proceeds of the offering will be used for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures and working capital.
